title: Growth Credits and Servicing Fee Draws: Plan Settings for Set-Aside Accounts
content:
Two accounting settings differ across the plans of Set-Aside Accounts: whether the undisbursed balance grows each month, and whether the monthly HECM servicing fee is drawn from the set-aside. The rounding rule for growth credits and computed disbursements is the same for every plan.

| Plan | Balance grows monthly | Growth spread over the loan's note rate (percentage points) | Day of the month growth for the prior month is credited | Monthly HECM servicing fee drawn from the set-aside | Servicing fees once the set-aside is exhausted | Rounding of growth credits and computed disbursements |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory) | Yes | 0.5 | 1 | No | Not applicable | Half up to the cent |
| Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) | Yes | 0.5 | 1 | No | Not applicable | Half up to the cent |
| Partially Funded LESA | Yes | 0.5 | 1 | No | Not applicable | Half up to the cent |
| Repair Set-Aside | No | 0.0 | 0 (none) | No | Not applicable | Half up to the cent |
| Servicing Fee Set-Aside | No | 0.0 | 0 (none) | Yes | Fee charged to the loan balance without the set-aside | Half up to the cent |
| Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve | No | 0.0 | 0 (none) | No | Not applicable | Half up to the cent |

## Notes

- The annual growth rate of a growing plan is the HECM loan's note rate plus the growth spread; a spread of 0.5 percentage points on a hypothetical note rate of 6.25 percent gives an annual growth rate of 6.75 percent.
- A spread of 0.0 and a posting day of 0 mean the plan's balance does not grow.
- Under the Servicing Fee Set-Aside, once the set-aside is exhausted, servicing fees are still charged to the loan balance but nothing is drawn from the set-aside.
